{{Conjecture|legends}}
Two different groups from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]] resisted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==First resistance==
{{Main|Battle of Svivren}}

Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Cevva Xuz]] thrived on the planet [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]], having passed several weapons through local customs. Although Xuz had known links with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Touno]] was unable or unwilling to arrest him. Pressured by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who was looking for a different prey, Touno sent [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strok (Galactic Empire)|Strok]] to arrest Xuz. When he tried to, Xuz's group answered with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. At the end of the battle, several stormtroopers and bystanders had been killed.<ref name="mj">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref>

==Second resistance==
{{Main|Siege of Svivren}}

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] attacked Svivren and several other worlds aligned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was opposed by the locals, the [[Svivreni]] species, who disliked very much the idea of being sieged.<ref name="SB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', repeated in ''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> This caught the Imperials flat-footed. After several failed attempts against the Svivreni resistance, the Imperial Navy retreated,<ref name="geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> only to return later and try to occupy Svivren. For a long time, the Imperials were unsuccessful at fighting the local resistance,<ref name="SB" /> and their plight was well-known enough to have reached the ears of [[Samuel Tomas Gillespee]], by then living at [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
